name: io.github.motazalmaroai/x402-arabic-api
title: x402 Arabic API
description: Arabic<->English translation and Arabic summarization, paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of YOUR OWN Base wallet holding USDC. Optional: without it, paid tools only return the price and pay nothing.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TOTAL_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Session cap in USDC: total spend per server process (default 0.50).
